title: Deterministic legacy importer
description: Objective: import copied frozen old-Moe projects read-only with stable IDs, ordering, provenance, ambiguity classification, and atomic replay. Deliverable: packages/import modules and real-project fixtures. NOT in scope: live legacy reads, write-back, dual write, or activation. Hard dependencies: stable v1 schemas, store migrations, and artifact CAS. Owned paths: packages/import/** and tests/migration/import/**. Verification: pnpm test:migration.
definitionOfDone: Identical source bytes produce identical imported IDs, events, database/export hashes, and counts.
Unsupported or ambiguous records are preserved with typed provenance and never activate.
Interrupted import commits wholly or not at all and legacy bytes remain unchanged.
taskRails: Portability consumes frozen daemon/core contracts; adapters cannot fork lifecycle or authority semantics.
Official MCP stdio and Streamable HTTP only; no custom MCP-over-WebSocket dialect.
Unsupported OS/provider/import facts remain typed UNSUPPORTED or UNKNOWN, never guessed.
IDE adapters are thin optional shells for the standalone control room. Keep files below 400 lines and use explicit owned paths.
reopenReason: Promoted by governor-eae4fc53 2026-08-09 on human instruction. I resolved it by inspection instead, on disk: (1) artifact CAS EXISTS — packages/runner/src/artifacts/ ships artifact-contract.ts, artifact-node-fs.ts, artifact-store.ts with a content-digest surface and its own test; (2) store migrations EXIST and are settled — sqlite-schema-bootstrap/conformance/integrity plus the v3 projection-table migration (task-2d9b0a74, DONE) and the schema decomposition (task-9e3faf3b, DONE); (3) v1 schemas are stable — the store is at schema v3 with validateExactSchemaObjects pinning object SQL, and no schema task remains open. Owned paths packages/import/** and tests/migration/import/** are BOTH GREENFIELD — neither directory exists — so this cannot collide with anything in flight. ARCHITECT: verify those three premises on disk before naming symbols; if any turns out to be less settled than I read it, report_blocked and I will move it back rather than have you plan against a guess. That reversal is cheap and expected, not a failure. Explicitly NOT promoted alongside this: task-b937811e (Benchmark telemetry harness), whose clause "stable daemon/provider/control-room instrumentation" fails the same inspection — apps/daemon/src/index.ts still exports only advisory graph-preview types and the real command surface is being built right now by task-6054520b.
